text: Write the message in rows of a fixed width and give each row a single key letter, the rows cycling through a key word. Every letter in a row is shifted the same way.
So all known letters in one row must force the same key letter. On the sculpture's table at width 7, every row that holds two known letters forces two or more.
Widths 2 to 48 under 63 alphabets and three ways of adding: 559,629 cases, and no width survives.
